svg.text: L46 post-stop recovery: the most protected arm (h40) never re-organizes
stop = DNg88 −8, 20 s; 0.7 Hz entrain history before it; 120-s post window; S(Tr) rolling 5 s; seeds 11/22/33
A. H=40: protected through the stop — no post recovery
B. H=0: killed during — rebounds in seconds
C. per-side S — the stop inverts S R (h40)
